# AEM Code Analyser 1.0.5

<p class="muted">Released 2026-11-16 · <a href="../">All release notes</a> · <a href="https://github.com/RohithV16/aem-code-analyser/releases/tag/v1.0.5" rel="noopener">GitHub release</a></p>

> **Upgrading?** A rule added in a release can fail a gate that passed on the previous
> version. Run this version once on a branch (`aem-analyser . --no-html`) before bumping CI,
> and accept existing findings with `--update-baseline` when the change is deliberate.

## Fixed
{: #fixed}

- SARIF marks retired rule ids with `defaultConfiguration.enabled: false`, so consumers and the probe
  checker can distinguish a retired rule (`AEM-QUAL-006`) from one produced by another engine
  (`AEM-DUP-010`, PMD CPD). Without the distinction the new validation job demanded a probe for a
  rule that can never fire.
